```{r}
library(gt)
library(tibble)

tab <- tribble(
  ~Tasks, ~Features, ~KMtoIPD, ~IPDfromKM, ~KMGPT,
  "Data ingestion", "Number-at-risk table", "✗", "✓", "✓",
  "Data ingestion", "Auto data extraction", "✗", "✗", "✓",
  "Data ingestion", "Multiple KM curves in the same figure", "✗", "✗", "✗",

  "Extracts KM measures", "Curve digitization mode", "✗ External software", "✓ Manually", "✓ Automatic",
  "Extracts KM measures", "Axis calibration required", "✓", "✓ preprocess()", "✓",
  "Extracts KM measures", "Accepts externally digitized coordinates (time, S(t))", "✓", "✓", "✗",

  "Reconstruction procession", "Risk table missing", "✗ External software", "✓ Manually", "✓ Automatic",
  "Reconstruction procession", "Data standardization", "✓", "✓ preprocess()", "✓",
  "Reconstruction procession", "Censoring allowance", "✓", "✓", "✗",
  "Reconstruction procession", "Monotonicity enforcement", "✓", "✗", "✓",

)

tab %>%
  gt(
    rowname_col = "Features",
    groupname_col = "Tasks"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    KMtoIPD = "KMtoIPD",
    IPDfromKM = "IPDfromKM",
    KMGPT = "KMGPT"
  ) %>%
  tab_stubhead(label = "Features") %>%
  tab_caption("Table 1. Three main stage in reconstruction") %>%
  cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = c(KMtoIPD, IPDfromKM, KMGPT)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row_group.font.weight = "bold"
  )
```


```{r}
tab2 <- tribble(
  ~Tasks, ~Features, ~KMtoIPD, ~IPDfromKM, ~KM_GPT,

  # -------------------- Risk table --------------------
  "Risk table", "Uses number-at-risk table", "✗", "✓", "✓",
  "Risk table", "How risk table is used (constraint granularity)", 
  "Interval-level constraints (from KM + nrisk)", 
  "Interval-level constraints via preprocess()", 
  "Automatic extraction + interval constraints",
  "Risk table", "Supports calibration back to paper-reported quantities (e.g., total events / nrisk checks)", 
  "△ (implementation-dependent)", "△ (user-supplied totals)", "✓ (pipeline-supported)",
  "Risk table", "Robust to risk-table errors / can re-calibrate to match paper", 
  "✗", "△ (manual adjustment)", "✓ (automatic/iterative)",

  # -------------------- Censoring --------------------
  "Censoring", "Allows censoring in reconstructed IPD", "✓", "✓", "△",
  "Censoring", "Handles multiple censorings at identical time points (ties)", 
  "✓", "✓", "△ (not specified)",
  "Censoring", "Handles overlapping/occluded censor marks on the figure (extraction stage)", 
  "✗ (external digitization)", "✗ (manual/interactive)", "✓ (designed for noisy/overlapping marks)",
  "Censoring", "Within-interval censoring time allocation", 
  "User-supplied / conventional assumption", 
  "Default rule in getIPD() (often uniform within interval)", 
  "Adaptive / uncertainty-aware (method-specific)",
  "Censoring", "Administrative censoring / end-of-follow-up handling", 
  "✓ (implicit by max time)", "✓ (implicit by max time)", "✓ (explicit handling)",

  # -------- Reconstruction mechanics & assumptions -----
  "Reconstruction mechanics & assumptions", "Monotonicity correction for noisy/non-monotone digitized curves", 
  "✓", "△ (depends on preprocess settings)", "✓",
  "Reconstruction mechanics & assumptions", "Event vs censor assignment within a time interval (rule-based)", 
  "✓", "✓", "△ (not specified)",
  "Reconstruction mechanics & assumptions", "Supports log-scaled time axis", 
  "✗", "✗", "✓",
  "Reconstruction mechanics & assumptions", "Stochastic reconstruction (randomness) + reproducibility controls (seed)", 
  "△", "△", "✓"
)

tab2 %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Features", groupname_col = "Tasks") %>%
  cols_label(
    KMtoIPD  = "KMtoIPD",
    IPDfromKM = "IPDfromKM",
    KM_GPT   = "KM-GPT"
  ) %>%
  tab_stubhead(label = "Features") %>%
  tab_caption("Table 2. Reconstruction options and assumptions across IPD reconstruction methods.") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(KMtoIPD, IPDfromKM, KM_GPT)) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    data_row.padding = px(3)
  )


```
